svg.text: Every closure since 2019, three ports, one detector
Container calls as a ratio to the trailing median. Orange: days at or below 25% of baseline.
Blue marks: storms whose 34-kt wind field reached the port (NOAA IBTrACS); the named ones are in the README.
Not every closure is a storm: fog, holidays and the 2022 lockdown show up too. The detector marks days, the storm file names them.
